messages:
maria (product): quick sync: PRD draft for token lifecycle + RBAC scoping ready for review — want alignment on customer-facing acceptance criteria before we freeze scope. TL;DR: support org/project-scoped tokens, API key -> service account mapping, token rotation with 7d default TTL.
sam (eng): quick q: do we allow overlapping scopes? e.g., org-wide token + project-specific? Acme asked for project-only tokens.
oliver (sec): :thinking_face: we need a clear revocation path for compromised keys. propose KMS-backed signing, token versioning, and an active revocation list with forced session flush where possible.
jess (pm): Acceptance criteria proposal:
1) create token with scope `project:123` -> only access project resources
2) token revocation observable in <30s for Hosted, SLA target for Dedicated
3) audit logs for create/use/revoke (who, where, token_id)
4) SDK + docs + migration guide
lee (infra): impl note: encode scope in JWT `scp` claim, formats:
- org: `scp: "org:ORG_ID"`
- project: `scp: "org:ORG_ID:proj:PROJ_ID:roles=read,write"`
Example token payload snippet:
```
{ "sub":"svc:payments", "scp":"org:acme:proj:payments:roles=writer", "exp":1710000000 }
```
maria (product): Edge case: org admins ask for 'break glass' tokens that bypass project scoping. Do we allow? it creates audit/review complexity.
sam (eng): Prioritization suggestion: Phase 1 = project-scoped tokens, revocation API, audit. Phase 2 = hierarchical RBAC, admin bypass, token UI.
oliver (sec): Security reqs: token minting must enforce SSO for org-admins, 2FA option, TTL upper bound 365d, recommend default 7d. include automatic rotation endpoints and key-rotation policy.
jess (pm): Launch checklist: docs + SDK changes, e2e tests, canary rollout in Hosted, Dedicated readiness doc. customer acceptance test: Acme and Beacon run smoke tests against token flows.
dev-bot: New PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345 opened — token-lifecycle: PRD + basic impl sketches.
lee (infra): open question: allow multiple API keys per service account (yes) but must include `key_id` for rotation and per-key audit. also consider rate-limit per-key vs per-service-account.
maria (product): @sam @lee @oliver @jess owners assigned. i'll update PRD with acceptance criteria + phased roll plan. deadline: EOD Fri.
sam (eng): i'll draft the RFC for token format + revocation API by Tue. will link tests.
jess (pm): added notes in PRD doc: https://redwoodhq.internal/docs/prd/token-lifecycle — pls comment.
maria (product): wrapping up here — will reconvene after RFC drafts. :spiral_calendar:
